dedupe_keys.name: 1 minute residential load profiles under electrification scenarios for new zealand and german cities resloadsim

description: This data set gives synthetic residential electricity demand at 1-minute resolution for a full year in four cities: Oldenburg and Karlsruhe in Germany and Auckland and Christchurch in New Zealand. It was published on Zenodo in May 2025 by Stella Steidl, Alejandro Zabala Figueroa, Rebecca Peer, Heinz Wilkening, Alaa Alhamwi, Wided Medjroubi and Jannik Haas. Profiles were generated with resLoadSIM version 6.2.0, a residential load simulator developed by the European Commission that models appliance-level demand from occupant behaviour, appliance ownership and usage statistics. Each city has a reference scenario for the current energy mix and four future scenarios with more electric space heating and electric vehicles, using 2022 weather, aggregated to the city level with 525,600 time steps. Input parameters with sources and Python visualisation scripts are included. Coverage is the four cities. The data are a zipped archive of about 1 GB, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: profiles are simulated, not measured, and only city totals are given. Simulation uses are distribution grid planning for heat pump and electric vehicle uptake and peak demand studies. Related records: data-india-state-daily-electricity-demand is a measured demand series.
